onlyVideos: Only MP4 / MOV videos can be added here
drop: Drop videos here (MP4 or MOV: chapters, several cameras…)

noVideo.title: No video?
noVideo.text: Export only the widgets as a transparent image sequence, timed by the telemetry, to composite later.

hint: The first video is the timeline reference and sets the output format (editable in Export). Other videos are placed automatically: GoPro chapters chain, cameras align by GPS time or speed. Telemetry is read from GoPro videos and from the DJI .SRT file next to a video.
